name: Nachon
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: When they came to Nachon's threshingfloor, the oxen shook the cart, and Uzzah put forth his hand and took hold of the ark. The anger of the Lord was kindled, and God smote him for his error, and he died there by the ark.

note.label: 2 Samuel 6: David Brings Up the Ark of God

points: When they came to the threshingfloor of Chidon, the oxen stumbled and Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark.
